decisive_items: a 1.09 × 0.79 cm well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow
left testis was enlarged, firm, smooth, without discrete nodules or tenderness
response.rationale: Testicular cancer is favored by a painless firm testicular mass with an intratesticular vascular lesion and elevated CA19-9; epididymal cysts are bilateral and incidental, while torsion is contradicted by lack of tenderness and ultrasound findings.

rejected.why: Epididymal cysts are bilateral and not the dominant intratesticular lesion; they do not explain the hypoechoic vascular mass or elevated CA19-9.
Acute worsening is nonspecific; absence of tenderness and presence of a well-defined lesion with blood flow argue against torsion.
